job.title: Saarbrücken Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service (mwd) (Vollzeit Teilzeit) 66115

tailoring.headline: Senior Consultant – SAP CX Support & Integration | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Proven expertise in SAP CX platforms, designing and supporting REST/OCC APIs, PIM-ERP-MDM integrations, and headless commerce. Strong techno-functional consulting skills: gathering requirements, writing user stories, and translating business needs into robust e-commerce implementations. Experienced in production support, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes, and AI-assisted development. Valid German work permit, remote-ready across Germany.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service
cover_en.hook: I am excited about ORBIS’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge SAP CX and CPQ solutions that empower customers. With over five years of hands-on experience building and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in SAP CX, integration, and end-to-end e-commerce delivery.

bullets.label: SAP CX Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, delivering headless APIs and product catalog management that align with SAP CX best practices.

bullets.label: Integration & API
bullets.text: Built OCC REST services and end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM data pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring seamless integration across enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Acted as a bridge between business and IT, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and translating them into robust SAP Commerce implementations.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Provided 24/7 production support, resolved integration bottlenecks, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) to maintain high availability.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to ORBIS.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von ORBIS, innovative SAP CX- und CPQ-Lösungen zu realisieren, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell verfüge ich über fundiertes Know-how in SAP CX, Integration und End-to-End-E-Commerce-Projekten.

bullets.label: SAP CX Expertise
bullets.text: Entwickelte und implementierte SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) Lösungen, inklusive Headless-APIs und Produktkatalog-Management nach SAP-CX-Standards.

bullets.label: Integration & API
bullets.text: Erstellte OCC-REST-Services und end-to-end PIM-ERP-MDM-Datenpipelines mit Profisee, DataHub und Hotfolders für nahtlose Systemintegration.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Agierte als Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereichen und IT, erfasste Anforderungen, schrieb User Stories und funktionale Spezifikationen und setzte sie in SAP-Commerce-Lösungen um.

bullets.label: Produktionssupport
bullets.text: Leistete 24/7-Produktionssupport, löste Integrationsengpässe und führte CI/CD-Deployments auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) durch.

cover_de.logistics: Karlsruhe, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis, letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintrittstermin 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu ORBIS zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: ORBIS stands out as a leader in digital transformation, combining deep SAP CX expertise with innovative CPQ solutions that drive measurable business value. Your focus on customer-centric platforms and continuous improvement aligns perfectly with my passion for delivering high-performance SAP Commerce implementations. I am eager to contribute my SAP CX integration experience to help ORBIS expand its market impact and deliver next-generation solutions for clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join ORBIS to apply my SAP CX expertise in a forward-thinking environment that values innovative CPQ solutions and delivers real business impact.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience in SAP CX integration. I’m interested in the Senior Consultant Support SAP CX role at ORBIS and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Consultant Support SAP CX, CPQ & SAP Service position. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong integration skills, and a proven record of delivering SAP CX solutions. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for ORBIS.

Kind regards,
